question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior remain external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and feasible within the plugin, but it changes official retrieval semantics, config/defaults, persistent FTS index behavior, and fallback policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Implement official plugin-local hybrid retrieval
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep advanced retrieval external
options.body: Leave official memory-lancedb vector-only and point advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank workflows to community packages or ClawHub.

options.title: Document vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after documenting that memory-lancedb is a vector backend while memory-core owns built-in hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement official plugin-local hybrid retrieval
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from current memory-lancedb history, adjacent memory-core work, and prior reviewer context on this issue.
